card.name: Word just before a likely J name
card.fires_on: Ordinary words (swallow, of, when, on) placed right before a J-initial word such as JUXTAPID, JAKAFI, Jupiter, or Jr. The marked word itself is not J-related; the next word is predicted to start with J.

modes.label: Before JUXTAPID/JAKAFI
modes.description: Linking words in drug-label text just ahead of the brand names JUXTAPID or JAKAFI.

modes.label: Before J-planet or J-name in web text
modes.description: Small words in general text where a J-initial name, like Jupiter or a person's name, might come next.

card.writes: It raises the chance that the next word begins with a lowercase j and lowers capital J.
card.plain: It fires on a word just before a likely J-word, such as a J-brand drug name, and nudges the model toward that J.
